transcription_cross_check: Every line was transcribed from 150/300 dpi renders and compared word by word and number by number with an independent Tesseract 5 (psm 6) OCR pass of 300 dpi page strips, full width and per column half; all 47 disagreements were OCR misreads of white-on-dark headings, symbols (⎓, ≤, °, ×, ℃) or artwork, re-read on 300 dpi strips and 6x clips (temperature dashes, the full-width comma and colon, the ℃ glyph, USB-A rating hyphens, double spaces). Specifications, LCD, troubleshooting, safety and warranty numbers were re-read digit by digit.
